0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_GREETING_ANDEN_000_000
0.description: Assuming I was a shepherd, seeing items used for tending sheep may help me remember something crucial. At least, I hope it will...
0.translation_description: Se fossi un pastore, vedere gli strumenti per accudire le pecore potrebbe aiutarmi a ricordare qualcosa d'importante. Almeno, lo spero...

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_GREETING_ANDEN_000_001
1.description: It still gets chilly at nighttime, but these mountains were once frigid. What do you think I used to stave off the cold?
1.translation_description: Di notte fa ancora freddo, ma un tempo queste montagne erano gelide. Secondo te, cosa usavo per ripararmi dal freddo?

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_GREETING_ANDEN_000_002
2.description: Hello, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I do hate to keep troubling you, but might I see some items that a person might eat?
2.translation_description: Ciao, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Mi spiace disturbarti ancora, ma potrei vedere qualcosa che si possa mangiare?

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_GREETING_ANDEN_000_003
3.description: Good <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!<hex:02100103>I feel likely to regain the rest of my memories at any moment. Just a little further, and I'm sure to recall my true form.
3.translation_description: <hex:02084BE3E90C0DFF2002081CE3E90C05FF0A42756F6E6173657261FF0B42756F6E67696F726E6F03FF24020820E3E90C12FF0F42756F6E612067696F726E617461FF0A42756F6E61736572610303>, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!<hex:02100103>Sento che la memoria sta per tornare del tutto da un momento all'altro. Ancora un piccolo sforzo e sono certo che ricorderò la mia vera forma.

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_GREETING_ANDEN_000_004
4.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Always so good to see you, my friend.
4.translation_description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! È sempre un piacere rivederti, amico mio.

43.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_TUTORIAL_000_000
43.description: Help Anden achieve his goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with him and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
43.translation_description: Aiuta Anden a raggiungere i suoi obiettivi consegnandogli oggetti da collezione. Per saperne di più, parlargli e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scopri le Consegne Personalizzate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

54.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_TUTORIAL_001_000
54.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Anden's trust.
54.translation_description: Con la tua prima consegna riuscita hai iniziato a conquistare la fiducia di Anden.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_TUTORIAL_001_001
55.description: With each successful delivery, Anden will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Anden's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about him.
55.translation_description: A ogni consegna riuscita, Anden sarà sempre più soddisfatto dei tuoi sforzi. Quando l'indicatore è pieno, il suo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>grado di soddisfazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenta e ti permette di scoprire altro su di lui.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_TUTORIAL_001_002
56.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Anden needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new leafy acquaintance!
56.translation_description: Puoi effettuare fino a sei consegne a settimana. Portagli gli oggetti che gli servono, e fallo spesso per conquistare la fiducia e la riconoscenza del tuo nuovo amico frondoso!

57.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_WEEKLYLIMIT_000_000
57.translation_description: Hai raggiunto il limite settimanale di consegne. Potrai ricominciare da <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

58.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_001_000
58.description: Tending sheep requires food, medicine, trimming shears, cleaning supplies... Oooh, what's that you have there?
58.translation_description: Per accudire le pecore servono cibo, medicine, cesoie, prodotti per la pulizia... Oh, cos'hai lì?

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_001_001
59.description: Mountainous climes are nothing to sneeze at. Rather, they <hex:021A020203>would<hex:021A020103> be without warm clothing or blankets or some such thing.
59.translation_description: Le zone montuose non scherzano. Anzi, senza abiti caldi, coperte e simili <hex:021A020203>sarebbero<hex:021A020103> proibitive.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_001_002
60.description: Voeburtite cuisine may prominently feature lamb and mutton, but rest assured that sheep cuisine prominently features leafman fronds. What goes around comes around, I suppose...
60.translation_description: La cucina voeburtiana propone spesso agnello e castrato, ma ti assicuro che nella dieta delle pecore abbondano le fronde degli uomini-foglia. Chi la fa l'aspetti, direi...

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_001_003
61.description: Voeburt once boasted a high population of artisans who crafted armor and weapons and all sorts of little things. I have no doubt a master craftsperson stands somewhere in these flowering fields─a leafman forever dreaming of creation!
61.translation_description: Un tempo Voeburt era popolata da artigiani che fabbricavano armature, armi e ogni sorta di piccoli oggetti. Sono certo che in questi campi fioriti si nasconda un artigiano provetto: un uomo-foglia sempre intento a sognare nuove creazioni!

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_001_004
62.description: I've been giving Eo Tyr milk and sweets like I used to, but if you've anything handmade that you think they might enjoy, I'd be most obliged.
62.translation_description: Ho continuato a dare latte e dolci a Eo Tyr come un tempo, ma te ne sarei grato se mi portassi qualcosa fatto a mano che possa fare loro piacere.

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_002_000
63.description: Being chewed on by sheep is not an entirely pleasant sensation, believe you me...but providing for them brings me great satisfaction. However, leaves alone do not a diet make─sheep need hay and a salt lick, at the very least.
63.translation_description: Farsi masticare dalle pecore non è affatto piacevole, credimi... ma prendermi cura di loro mi dà grande soddisfazione. Le sole foglie, però, non bastano a nutrirle: servono almeno fieno e un blocco di sale.

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_002_001
64.description: It's natural for people to weather harsh climes by burning fuel for warmth. But once you understand what it means to be potential kindling, you never see fire the same way again!
64.translation_description: È naturale bruciare combustibile per scaldarsi quando fa molto freddo. Ma dopo aver capito cosa significa poter diventare legna da ardere, non guardi più il fuoco allo stesso modo!

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_002_002
65.description: Considering the purity of the streams and quality of the soil, this area may be perfect for cultivating vegetables. It's little wonder why all the leafmen here are so verdant and lush.
65.translation_description: La limpidezza dei corsi d'acqua e la qualità del terreno fanno di questa zona il luogo ideale per coltivare ortaggi. Non c'è da stupirsi se gli uomini-foglia qui sono così rigogliosi.

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_002_003
66.description: Between mineral resources from the mountains and yields from my flock, supplies for crafting seem more than plentiful here. Do you think the climate might even accommodate for cotton? In the warmer seasons, of course...
66.translation_description: Con le risorse minerarie delle montagne e i prodotti del mio gregge, qui non mancano certo i materiali per gli artigiani. Pensi che il clima possa persino consentire la coltivazione del cotone? Naturalmente, nella stagione più calda...

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_002_004
67.description: I asked Eo Tyr what other sorts of things they like, and they said “shiny stones and fragrant flowers.” Rather reminds me of what Tellina used to collect when she was young...
67.translation_description: Ho chiesto a Eo Tyr cos'altro gli piacesse e mi ha risposto: «Pietre luccicanti e fiori profumati». Mi ricorda quel che Tellina raccoglieva da bambina...

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_003_000
68.description: These sheep look so content as they graze, but grass alone won't bring out the luster of their wool. A good supplement to their diet might, though... Seaweed, perhaps?
68.translation_description: Queste pecore sembrano così contente mentre pascolano, ma l'erba da sola non rende la loro lana più lucente. Forse un'aggiunta alla dieta potrebbe aiutare... Alghe, magari?

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_003_001
69.description: Warm soup sounds like a delightful way to stave off the cold─and I daresay freshwater fish would produce some excellent stock.
69.translation_description: Una zuppa calda sarebbe un ottimo modo per scaldarsi e, direi, il pesce d'acqua dolce darebbe un brodo eccellente.

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_003_002
70.description: The sea seems rather far away, but delicious freshwater creatures are surely plentiful in these rivers and lakes. If the surface freezes? Why, simply cut a hole through the ice!
70.translation_description: Il mare sembra lontanissimo, ma di certo questi fiumi e laghi pullulano di deliziose creature d'acqua dolce. E se la superficie gela? Basta aprire un varco nel ghiaccio!

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_003_003
71.description: If your handicraft serves a practical purpose, it may very well need repairs at some point. A clever artisan chooses materials readily available to them, and few sources are more reliable than all these lakes and rivers...
71.translation_description: Se un oggetto artigianale ha uno scopo pratico, prima o poi potrebbe aver bisogno di riparazioni. Un artigiano ingegnoso sceglie materiali che ha a portata di mano, e queste distese d'acqua ne offrono in abbondanza...

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_KNOWLEDGE_ANDEN_003_004
72.description: Pixies seem to have a particular weakness for pretty colors─or, at least, Eo Tyr does. If you happen to find any alluring shells or whatnot, I'd be most grateful to take them off your hands.
72.translation_description: A quanto pare, le pixie vanno matte per i colori vivaci... o almeno Eo Tyr. Se trovi conchiglie graziose o qualcosa del genere, sarò felice di prenderle da te.

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_JUDGEMENT_ANDEN_000_000
73.description: Oooh! How lovely. You have my gratitude, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
73.translation_description: Oh! Che meraviglia. Grazie di cuore, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_JUDGEMENT_ANDEN_000_001
74.description: Your generosity is humbling, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Truly, I thank you!
74.translation_description: La tua generosità mi lascia senza parole, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Ti ringrazio davvero!

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_JUDGEMENT_ANDEN_000_002
75.description: F-For me!? I cannot fully express how grateful I feel, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>... Oooh, thank you, thank you, and thank you again!
75.translation_description: P-Per me!? Non so esprimere quanto te ne sia grato, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>... Oh, grazie, grazie e ancora grazie!

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_FULLBAG_000_000
76.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.
76.translation_description: Impossibile ottenere la ricompensa: l'inventario è pieno.

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_FULLBAG_000_001
77.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Anden once more.
77.translation_description: Per ritirare la ricompensa, fai spazio nell'inventario e parla di nuovo con Anden.

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_000_000
78.description: You have brought me so many nice things─it's a shame I can't put any of them to use. I daresay I'm far closer to sheep nourish<hex:021A020203>ment<hex:021A020103> than nourish<hex:021A020203>er<hex:021A020103> in my current state.
78.translation_description: Mi hai portato così tante belle cose, eppure non posso usarne nessuna. Nello stato in cui sono, temo di essere molto più <hex:021A020203>cibo per pecore<hex:021A020103> che <hex:021A020203>pastore<hex:021A020103>.

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_000_001
79.description: But that regret in and of itself feels like a clue─and these items do seem profoundly familiar, somehow. Hmm...
79.translation_description: Eppure, anche questo rimpianto sembra un indizio... e in qualche modo questi oggetti mi sono molto familiari. Mmh...

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_001_000
80.description: Come to think of it, if the climate here had stayed as cold as it was, I would have wilted and died straightaway, correct? A chilling thought.
80.translation_description: A pensarci bene, se il clima fosse rimasto così freddo, sarei appassito e morto in un attimo, vero? Mi vengono i brividi solo a pensarci.

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_001_001
81.description: I suppose this floral paradise is my unexpected savior─as are you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Thanks to you, I think I've remembered something more of my past...
81.translation_description: Forse questo paradiso in fiore mi ha salvato inaspettatamente, proprio come te, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Grazie a te credo di aver ricordato qualcosa in più del mio passato...

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_002_000
82.description: Water and sunlight provide all the sustenance a plant could ever need, but after looking at these foodstuffs, I can't help but feel a strong affinity for eating. Oooh, yes, I do miss a good chew...
82.translation_description: Acqua e luce solare bastano a nutrire una pianta, ma dopo aver visto tutto questo cibo non posso fare a meno di sentirmi attratto dal mangiarlo. Oh, sì, mi manca proprio qualcosa da sgranocchiare...

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_002_001
83.description: ...No, this is no time for swallowing! Er, wallowing. Just a little more, Anden─remember what once you ate!
83.translation_description: ...No, non è il momento di deglutire! Ehm, di commuovermi. Ancora un po', Anden: ricorda cosa mangiavi un tempo!

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_003_000
84.description: I must say, recently it feels easier than ever to recall details from my former life. I'm all aflutter, and I don't just mean the breeze through my branches.
84.translation_description: Ultimamente mi sembra che i ricordi della mia vita passata riaffiorino con più facilità che mai. Sono tutto un fremito... e non parlo solo della brezza tra i rami.

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_BEFRANKUP_ANDEN_003_001
85.description: I have little doubt that it's all thanks to you and these incredibly familiar supplies you've been bringing me. The desire to put my hands on them is overwhelming...
85.translation_description: Non ho dubbi: è merito tuo e di queste provviste così familiari che mi porti. Il desiderio di metterci le mani sopra è irresistibile...

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_001
86.description: Oooh! That's it! I-I've remembered something.
86.translation_description: Oh! È questo! Mi è... mi è tornato in mente qualcosa.

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_002
87.description: You were right, Eo Tyr─I <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> a shepherd. And I lived here with my sheep and cared for them very, very much.
87.translation_description: Avevi ragione, Eo Tyr: io <hex:021A020203>ero<hex:021A020103> un pastore. Vivevo qui con le mie pecore e mi prendevo cura di loro, davvero tanto.

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_001_003
88.description: Yes! That's right, Anden. Go on, go on.

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_004
89.description: Originally, we lived up on the mountainside, across the lake. But when the Flood came, we were forced to evacuate down here. Oooh, my little flock didn't like the move one bit. They never got along with the local shepherds...though I'm sure they do now that their wardens are tasty leafmen!
89.translation_description: All'inizio vivevamo sul fianco della montagna, oltre il lago. Ma quando arrivò l'Inondazione fummo costretti a trasferirci qui sotto. Oh, al mio piccolo gregge non piacque affatto il trasloco. Non andavano d'accordo con i pastori del posto... anche se immagino che ora li apprezzino, visto che i loro custodi sono diventati gustosi uomini-foglia!

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_005
90.description: And there was one other they didn't take to, as I remember.
90.translation_description: A quanto ricordo, ce n'era un altro con cui non andavano d'accordo.

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_006
91.description: Back before the Flood, a Galdjent traveler once assisted me with some work. Perhaps it was due to his hulking stature, but my sheep couldn't see him but to batter him with their tiny hooves. Heh! I shouldn't laugh, but the sight was really quite charming...
91.translation_description: Prima dell'Inondazione, un viaggiatore Galdjent mi aiutò una volta con alcuni lavori. Forse per la sua corporatura imponente, ma le mie pecore non facevano che prenderlo a cornate con i loro piccoli zoccoli. Ah! Non dovrei ridere, ma era uno spettacolo davvero buffo...

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_007
92.description: Wh-What's this? Have I returned to my true form!?
92.translation_description: C-Cosa? Sono tornato alla mia vera forma!?

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_008
93.description: But I've hardly remembered anything! No, this doesn't feel right─I can say with relative certainty that I was never this gigantic.
93.translation_description: Ma non ho ricordato quasi niente! No, non mi sembra giusto... posso affermare con una certa sicurezza che non sono mai stato così gigantesco.

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_001_009
94.description: Tee hee hee! Ahahaha! So anxious, Anden. No need to fret!
94.translation_description: Ih ih ih! Ahahah! Sei proprio ansioso, Anden. Non agitarti!

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_001_010
95.description: This is only a glamour─just a teeny-tiny taste of who you might-have-may-have-sort-have been. Or not! Either way, I've kept that fluffy, leafy head of yours for luck. How precious you look!
95.translation_description: È solo un'illusione... un assaggino piccino picciò di quel che forse eri, o avresti potuto essere! O magari no! Comunque, quella tua testolina soffice e frondosa me la tengo come portafortuna. Che tesoro!

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_001_011
96.description: I thought you'd feel more comfortable with the appearance of a mortal. And the more limbs you have, the more I can make them flail!
96.translation_description: Pensavo ti sentissi più a tuo agio con l'aspetto di un mortale. E con più arti posso farti sbracciare molto di più!

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_012
97.description: I-I suppose this does make communication easier in a fashion... But what's this about making me flail!?
97.translation_description: I-Immagino che così comunicare sia più facile... Ma cosa intendi con «farmi sbracciare»!?

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_001_013
98.description: Ahahaha! That's right, just like that. Oh, you are ever so droll!
98.translation_description: Ahahah! Proprio così, continua pure. Sei sempre così spassoso!

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_014
99.description: Oooh, why must you delight in my discomfort? Thanks to you, I'm bound to be battered to mulch by my adorable charges!
99.translation_description: Oh, perché ti diverti tanto a mettermi a disagio? Per colpa tua i miei adorabili protetti finiranno per ridurmi in poltiglia!

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_015
100.description: Which─ Well, I suppose there are worse ways to go...
100.translation_description: Be'... a pensarci, ci sono modi peggiori di andarsene...

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_001
101.description: I think I remember splitting firewood! And resenting that I had to do so, as I much preferred tending to the sheep.
101.translation_description: Credo di ricordare che spaccassi la legna! E che mi scocciassi di doverlo fare, perché preferivo di gran lunga badare alle pecore.

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_002_002
102.description: Yes, yes! You never <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> tear yourself away from your sweet fluffies, Anden. You'd forget all about your chopping and then have to do it in the middle of the driving snow. You'd be out there shivering and sniffling and muttering such dark words!
102.translation_description: Sì, sì! Non riuscivi mai a staccarti dai tuoi adorati batuffoli, Anden. Ti dimenticavi di spaccare la legna, così dovevi farlo nel bel mezzo di una bufera. Restavi lì a tremare, a tirare su col naso e a borbottare parole assai poco gentili!

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_003
103.description: Y-You saw all of that? Oooh...
103.translation_description: L-Lo hai visto tutto tu? Oh...

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_004
104.description: W-Well, firewood aside, I do remember enjoying a comfortable life here!
104.translation_description: C-Comunque, a parte la legna da ardere, ricordo che qui vivevo agiatamente!

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_005
105.description: You see, wool was always in high demand, here in...Voeburt, was it? Yes, Voeburt! That's what this place was called.
105.translation_description: Vedi, qui la lana era sempre molto richiesta... a Voeburt, giusto? Sì, Voeburt! Così si chiamava questo posto.

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_006
106.description: I would have my wool spun to yarn in the castle town, and as knitting was a rather popular pastime, people were happy to pay good coin for it. One can never have too many pairs of fuzzy socks, after all.
106.translation_description: Facevo filare la mia lana nella città del castello e, dato che lavorare a maglia era un passatempo molto popolare, la gente era disposta a pagarla profumatamente. D'altronde, non si hanno mai abbastanza paia di calzini morbidi.

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_007
107.description: Speaking of, I remember gifting a pair of woolen gloves to a traveler once. Someone who helped me with an errand... An elf! Yes, I once knew an elf who was rather averse to the cold...
107.translation_description: A proposito, ricordo di aver regalato un paio di guanti di lana a un viaggiatore. Mi aveva aiutato con una commissione... Un elfo! Sì, conoscevo un elfo che soffriva molto il freddo...

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_008
108.description: Oooh? I've changed again. Eo Tyr!?
108.translation_description: Oh! Sono cambiato di nuovo. Eo Tyr!?

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_002_010
110.description: Elven Anden! You look just like that Urianger fellow who used to live at the Bookman's Shelves. ...Well, I suppose he wasn't <hex:021A020203>quite<hex:021A020103> so leafy.
110.translation_description: Anden elfo! Sei identico a quell'Urianger che abitava agli Scaffali del Libraio. ...Anche se, a dire il vero, non era <hex:021A020203>proprio<hex:021A020103> così frondoso.

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_002_011
111.description: He's one of your friends, isn't he, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?
111.translation_description: È uno dei tuoi amici, vero, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_002_012
112.description: Oooh, Urianger was ever so fun to play with. He was too polite to say anything ill, so we would gift him treats he <hex:021A020203>loathed<hex:021A020103> and laugh at his sad face while he ate them. What fun we had! But you're just as entertaining, Anden─don't you fret.
112.translation_description: Oh, Urianger era così divertente! Era troppo educato per dire qualcosa di cattivo, così gli regalavamo dolci che <hex:021A020203>detestava<hex:021A020103> e ridevamo della sua faccia triste mentre li mangiava. Ci divertivamo un mondo! Ma anche tu sei uno spasso, Anden, non preoccuparti.

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_013
113.description: I-Is that supposed to be a good thing? I don't know whether to feel flattered or horrified...
113.translation_description: D-Dovrebbe essere un complimento? Non so se sentirmi lusingato o inorridito...

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_001
114.description: I've got it! I remember my favorite dish.
114.translation_description: Ci sono! Ricordo qual era il mio piatto preferito.

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_002
115.description: There was a tavern in the castle town that served an exquisite lamb stew. Normally, I would prepare my own meals, but that dish in particular I preferred to pay for.
115.translation_description: Nella città del castello c'era una taverna che serviva un delizioso stufato d'agnello. Di solito cucinavo da me, ma quello in particolare preferivo pagarlo.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_003_003
116.description: The first time I saw you eat sheep, Anden, I thought I had been thrown into the queerest of dreams. Oooh, to think the good, sweet, gentle shepherd would gobble up his friends with such delectable delight!
116.translation_description: La prima volta che ti ho visto mangiare pecora, Anden, mi è sembrato di trovarmi nel sogno più strano. Oh, pensare che il buon pastore dolce e gentile si sarebbe divorato i suoi amici con tanto gusto!

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_004
117.description: Well, being a shepherd is more than being a <hex:021A020203>friend<hex:021A020103> to sheep. Your duty is to ensure no part of their life goes to waste─you milk them, shear their wool, and one day, yes, see that their skin becomes leather and their bodies nourishment for others.
117.translation_description: Be', fare il pastore non significa soltanto essere <hex:021A020203>amico<hex:021A020103> delle pecore. Il tuo dovere è non sprecare nulla della loro vita: mungi il latte, tosali e, un giorno, fai sì che la loro pelle diventi cuoio e che la loro carne nutra gli altri.

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_005
118.description: We shepherds rely on our sheep for survival, especially in such unforgiving climes. So I did my utmost to repay their sacrifice with as happy and comfortable a life as I could provide.
118.translation_description: Noi pastori dipendevamo dalle pecore per sopravvivere, soprattutto in un clima tanto rigido. Perciò facevo del mio meglio per ripagare il loro sacrificio offrendo loro una vita felice e confortevole.

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_006
119.description: I believe they were happy, anyway. They say happy sheep provide better milk─and indeed, the cheese I made from their yield was quite popular at the tavern.
119.translation_description: Credo che fossero felici, almeno. Si dice che le pecore felici diano più latte e, in effetti, il formaggio che ricavavo era molto apprezzato alla taverna.

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_007
120.description: It paired wonderfully with ale─in fact, I remember one acquaintance of mine downing their weight in drink, so delighted were they by the combination. Their dwarven friend was perfectly appalled, scolded them something awful...
120.translation_description: Si accompagnava benissimo alla birra. Anzi, ricordo un conoscente che ne bevve quanto pesava, tanto gli piaceva quell'abbinamento. Il suo amico nano ne rimase inorridito e lo rimproverò di brutto...

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_008
121.description: <hex:021A020203>Eo Tyr<hex:021A020103>! Haven't you had your fun by now!?
121.translation_description: <hex:021A020203>Eo Tyr<hex:021A020103>! Non hai ancora avuto abbastanza divertimento!?

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_003_009
122.description: Tee hee heeeeee! Never enough fun, Anden─not when it's with you!
122.translation_description: Ih ih ih! Non mi divertirò mai abbastanza con te, Anden!

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_003_010
123.description: Oooh, Big Anden was strong and lovely, but Little Anden is <hex:021A020203>adorable<hex:021A020103> and lovely.
123.translation_description: Oh, il Grande Anden era forte e affascinante, ma il Piccolo Anden è <hex:021A020203>adorabile<hex:021A020103> e affascinante.

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_012
125.description: Oooh, don't think you can simply flatter your way out of my discontent! ...Even though you very well may!
125.translation_description: Oh, non credere di poterti liberare del mio malcontento con qualche complimento! ...Anche se forse potresti riuscirci!

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_001
126.description: Yes, I know these waves of inspiration well. Without a doubt, I passed many a happy evening absorbed in my crafting.
126.translation_description: Conosco bene queste ondate d'ispirazione. Senza dubbio trascorrevo tante belle serate assorto nei miei lavori d'artigianato.

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_002
127.description: I remember making and selling all sorts of things. Sheepskin rugs, for instance, and they fetched a good price too─nothing warms a stone house better!
127.translation_description: Ricordo che fabbricavo e vendevo un po' di tutto. Per esempio, tappeti di pelle di pecora, che fruttavano bene: niente scalda una casa di pietra come loro!

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_004_003
128.description: You had a warm, fluffy rug in your house too, Anden. Oooh, it was so very, very soft and lovely for snoozing.
128.translation_description: Anche tu avevi un tappeto morbido e soffice in casa, Anden. Oh, era così morbido e bello che ci si faceva un sonnellino meraviglioso.

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_004
129.description: Oooh, I did, didn't I! I remember becoming so absorbed in the finer points of crafting and leatherwork that I once petitioned different sorts of skin from this Mystel hunter I knew. What was their name again...
129.translation_description: Oh, è vero! Ricordo che mi appassionavo così tanto ai dettagli dell'artigianato e della lavorazione del cuoio che una volta chiesi pelli di vario tipo a un cacciatore mistel che conoscevo. Come si chiamava...

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_005
130.description: <sigh> Yeees, yes. I had a feeling this was coming.
130.translation_description: <sigh> Sììì, sì. Immaginavo che sarebbe andata così.

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_004_006
131.description: Hee hee hee! You know me so well, Anden.
131.translation_description: Ih ih ih! Mi conosci proprio bene, Anden.

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_004_007
132.description: But you don't have to restrain yourself. I do so love it when you bluster and fluster and wiggle about in delightful confusion. Go on, go on!
132.translation_description: Ma non devi trattenerti. Mi piace tanto quando sbuffi, ti agiti e ti dimeni in quella deliziosa confusione. Su, continua!

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_008
133.description: Eh? Be flustered on command? That's not─! How am I supposed to─? ...Oooh, I'm doing it, aren't I?
133.translation_description: Eh? Dovrei agitarmi a comando? Ma non...! Come dovrei...? Oh, lo sto facendo, vero?

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_004_009
134.description: That reminds me─they say there's a fiery red Mystel made entirely of crystal who is friends with our king. Any friend of the king must be friends with their sapling, right?
134.translation_description: A proposito, si dice che ci sia un mistel rosso fuoco, fatto interamente di cristallo, amico del nostro re. Se è amico del re, dev'essere amico anche del suo germoglio, no?

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_004_010
135.description: I knew it. Urianger and the crystal Mystel─what lovely friends you have!
135.translation_description: Lo sapevo! Urianger e il mistel di cristallo... che amici meravigliosi hai!

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_012
137.description: ...Do you suppose I had friends? I remember a particular group of people with whom I associated... Yes, they would help me with work sometimes, and...
137.translation_description: ...Chissà se avevo degli amici. Ricordo un gruppo di persone che frequentavo... Sì, a volte mi aiutavano con il lavoro e...

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_013
138.description: Oooh, that's right! Those people I've been remembering─they were travelers!
138.translation_description: Oh, ecco! Quelle persone che continuavo a ricordare erano viaggiatori!

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_014
139.description: A Galdjent...two elves...a dwarf and a Mystel...eh? There was one more, wasn't there? Who was it... A...Hume?
139.translation_description: Un Galdjent... due elfi... un nano e un mistel... Eh? Non c'era anche qualcun altro? Chi era? Un... Hume?

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_016
141.description: Wait, what's that look for? Did you know Ardbert as well?
141.translation_description: Aspetta, perché mi guardi così? Conoscevi anche tu Ardbert?

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_017
142.description: What a coincidence! Well, I suppose he <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> traverse the realm on his various adventures─but he and his comrades spent a winter here, once.
142.translation_description: Che coincidenza! Be', immagino che durante le sue avventure abbia <hex:021A020203>attraversato<hex:021A020103> il regno in lungo e in largo... ma una volta lui e i suoi compagni trascorsero qui l'inverno.

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_018
143.description: They helped me with all sorts of little requests and errands, and at the end of a long day's work, we often broke bread together.
143.translation_description: Mi aiutarono con ogni sorta di piccole faccende e commissioni e, alla fine di una lunga giornata di lavoro, spesso dividevamo il pane insieme.

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_019
144.description: Our first meeting was rather dramatic, though─I seemed to give them all quite a shock. But after that initial awkwardness, we became fast friends. If ever they ventured nearby, they would always make a point to call.
144.translation_description: Il nostro primo incontro fu piuttosto movimentato: a quanto pare, li spaventai tutti. Ma, superato quell'imbarazzo iniziale, diventammo grandi amici. Ogni volta che passavano da queste parti, venivano sempre a salutarmi.

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_020
145.description: ...Wait, why <hex:021A020203>were<hex:021A020103> they so shocked by me? Something feels odd...
145.translation_description: ...Aspetta, perché si erano <hex:021A020203>spaventati<hex:021A020103> tanto vedendomi? C'è qualcosa di strano...

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_001_100
146.description: Now you're sounding more like yourself! You did so love mingling with your sheepies, after all. Snuggling up in a sea of fluffy wool and happy bleating...although I doubt they'd let you snuggle looking like <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103>.
146.translation_description: Ora sembri più tu! Ti piaceva tanto stare con le tue pecorelle. Ti stringevi in un mare di lana soffice e belati felici... anche se dubito che ti avrebbero lasciato abbracciarle conciato <hex:021A020203>così<hex:021A020103>.

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_101
147.description: Snuggling... Yes, I must have done, seeing as it was so...cold outside?
147.translation_description: Abbracciarle... Sì, devo averlo fatto, visto quanto faceva... freddo fuori?

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_102
148.description: That's right. You wouldn't know it from this blossoming meadow, but these parts used to be far too cold for flowers. We <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> in the mountains, after all.
148.translation_description: Esatto. Da questo prato fiorito non si direbbe, ma un tempo qui faceva troppo freddo per i fiori. Dopotutto siamo <hex:021A020203>in<hex:021A020103> montagna.

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_103
149.description: I must have warded off the chill somehow─<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, could you bring me something I might have used to that end? Anything you can manage.
149.translation_description: In qualche modo dovevo proteggermi dal freddo. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, potresti portarmi qualcosa che avrei potuto usare? Va bene qualsiasi cosa.

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_002_100
150.description: Speaking of eating things both lovely and loathsome─have you remembered that you used to eat sheep, Anden?
150.translation_description: A proposito di cose deliziose e disgustose... ti è tornato in mente che un tempo mangiavi le pecore, Anden?

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_101
151.description: What!? I-I had no idea my obsession with sheep extended so far as to...<hex:021A020203>consume<hex:021A020103> them.
151.translation_description: Cosa!? N-Non sapevo che la mia passione per le pecore arrivasse al punto di... <hex:021A020203>mangiarle<hex:021A020103>.

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_102
152.description: But all things considered, I suppose that makes a certain degree of sense. ...It might also explain why I suddenly find myself craving roasted meat. Hmm.
152.translation_description: A pensarci, però, ha perfettamente senso... E forse spiega perché ora mi venga voglia di carne arrosto. Mmh.

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_103
153.description: Regardless, while diet is irrelevant to a leafman, I must have put consideration into my meals as a person. Any guess as to what I might have eaten?
153.translation_description: In ogni caso, anche se la dieta non conta per un uomo-foglia, da mortale devo aver badato a cosa mangiavo. Hai qualche idea?

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_EOTYR_003_100
154.description: Looking at Little Anden reminds me of how True Anden was once so enraptured by dwarven beards. Do all fluffy things fascinate you, Anden?
154.translation_description: Il Piccolo Anden mi ricorda quanto il Vero Anden fosse affascinato dalle barbe dei nani. Ti incantano proprio tutte le cose soffici, Anden?

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_101
155.description: Oooh, the beards! Yes, for the longest time, I assumed they were naturally grown from the chin, so I was surprised to discover that they actually attach at the helm.
155.translation_description: Oh, le barbe! Per tanto tempo ho creduto che crescessero naturalmente dal mento, così mi sorprese scoprire che in realtà si attaccavano all'elmo.

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_102
156.description: As an amateur artisan myself, I cannot help but admire such unique dwarven handicrafts.
156.translation_description: Da artigiano dilettante, non posso che ammirare queste creazioni naniche così originali.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_LCUT_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_103
157.description: ...Hm? Why did I say that? <hex:021A020203>Was<hex:021A020103> I an artisan? I do remember sitting before the hearth on snowy days and making...<hex:021A020203>something<hex:021A020103>. Handicrafts of some sort? Does that sound probable to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?
157.translation_description: ...Eh? Perché l'ho detto? <hex:021A020203>Ero<hex:021A020103> un artigiano? Ricordo che nelle giornate di neve sedevo accanto al focolare e realizzavo... <hex:021A020203>qualcosa<hex:021A020103>. Dei lavori artigianali, forse? Ti sembra plausibile, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUPINFO_000_000
158.description: Anden is pleased with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Probably Proper Person<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
158.translation_description: Anden è soddisfatto dei tuoi sforzi. Ora ti considera <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>una persona perbene, almeno in apparenza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUPINFO_000_001
159.description: Anden is delighted with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Tentatively True <hex:02081BE905FF0C547261646573776F6D616EFF0A5472616465736D616E03><hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUPINFO_000_002
160.description: Anden is overjoyed with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Just and Generous Journeyer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
160.translation_description: Anden è felicissimo dei tuoi sforzi. Ora ti considera <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>una persona giusta, generosa e sempre in viaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUPINFO_000_003
161.description: Anden could not be happier with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Familiar Friend-like Face<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
161.translation_description: Anden non potrebbe essere più felice dei tuoi sforzi. Ora ti considera <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>un volto amico e familiare<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUPINFO_001_001
162.description: And yet there is still much work to be done if he is to regain both his memories and true form. To that end, Anden has a new favor to ask of you...
162.translation_description: Eppure c'è ancora molto da fare prima che recuperi tutti i ricordi e la sua vera forma. Anden ha una nuova richiesta per te...

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUPINFO_001_002
163.description: Through your efforts, Anden has remembered much and more about his former life. It seems, however, that he has a different sort of question to ask you...
163.translation_description: Grazie ai tuoi sforzi, Anden ha ricordato molto della sua vita passata. Ora, però, vuole farti una domanda diversa...

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_AFTRANKUP_000_001
164.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Anden has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Anden and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
164.translation_description: L'elenco delle Consegne Personalizzate di Anden è stato aggiornato. Per vedere il nuovo elenco, parlargli e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Effettua una consegna<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_AFTRANKUP_001_001
165.description: A new quest continuing the story of Anden's efforts to regain his true form is now available. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Anden will be updated.
165.translation_description: È disponibile una nuova missione che prosegue la storia di Anden e dei suoi tentativi di recuperare la vera forma. Completandola, verrà aggiornato l'elenco delle Consegne Personalizzate.

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_000
170.description: Thank you for bringing me so many nice things, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
170.translation_description: Grazie per avermi portato tutte queste belle cose, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_001_001
171.description: It's always so good to chat with another person. These pixies certainly make their own fun, but their games can get rather exhausting at times...
171.translation_description: È sempre bello chiacchierare con un'altra persona. Queste pixie sanno divertirsi, ma a volte i loro giochi diventano piuttosto estenuanti...

172.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_000
172.description: I truly appreciate your efforts, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Thank you for bringing me so many helpful reminders.
172.translation_description: Apprezzo davvero i tuoi sforzi, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Grazie per avermi portato tanti utili promemoria.

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_002_001
173.description: I haven't much to offer in the way of recompense, but please feel free to snuggle a sheep or two before you go. It will both soothe and invigorate you like little else!
173.translation_description: Non ho molto da offrirti in cambio, ma prima di andare puoi coccolare una o due pecore. Poche cose sanno rilassarti e rinvigorirti come loro!

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_000
174.description: These exchanges of ours rather remind me of doing business in the castle town.
174.translation_description: Questi nostri scambi mi ricordano un po' gli affari nella città del castello.

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_001
175.description: Having spent most of my time either alone or with sheep, driving a hard bargain was never a skill I kept well honed. Oooh, those merchants used to haggle so ruthlessly! I never could get the deal I wanted...
175.translation_description: Avendo passato la maggior parte del tempo da solo o con le pecore, non ho mai affinato l'arte della contrattazione. Oh, quei mercanti mercanteggiavano senza pietà! Non riuscivo mai a spuntarla...

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_003_002
176.description: In that sense, handling Eo Tyr and the others feels far simpler than talking down a merchant thirsty for coin. ...I'm no longer fit for normal society, am I?
176.translation_description: In questo senso, trattare con Eo Tyr e gli altri è molto più semplice che tirare sul prezzo con un mercante avido di denaro. ...Non sono più adatto alla società civile, vero?

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_000
177.description: Oooh, I can't bear it anymore. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! These scrips we keep giving you─do you know where they come from? You <hex:021A020203>want<hex:021A020103> to know, don't you? Of course you do!
177.translation_description: Oh, non ne posso più! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Sai da dove vengono questi gettoni che continuiamo a darti? Lo <hex:021A020203>vuoi<hex:021A020103> sapere, vero? Certo che sì!

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_001
178.description: <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> certainly was curious, so I asked Lor Ul─and they said these scrips were “liberated” from mortals who wandered into Il Mheg. Liberated! What sort of neighborhood is this!?
178.translation_description: Anche <hex:021A020203>a me<hex:021A020103> la cosa incuriosiva parecchio, così ho chiesto a Lor Ul... e mi hanno detto che questi gettoni sono stati «liberati» dai mortali che si sono persi a Il Mheg. Liberati! Ma che razza di quartiere è questo!?

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_004_002
179.description: I've been positively sick with guilt, watching you accept your recompense with such innocent joy, unaware that it's all been nothing but contraband. Forgive me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>... Now you share my pain!
179.translation_description: Mi sentivo in colpa da morire a guardarti accettare la ricompensa con tanta innocenza, senza sapere che era tutta merce di contrabbando. Perdonami, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>... Ora sai come mi sento!

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_005_000
180.description: Might I ask for some advice, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Recently, Eo Tyr has been absolutely adamant that I become their sapling... As someone who took the leap, what do you think?
180.translation_description: Potresti darmi un consiglio, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Ultimamente Eo Tyr insiste perché diventi il suo germoglio... Tu hai accettato un patto simile: cosa ne pensi?

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_EOTYR_005_001
181.description: Pity me, royal sapling! I've been offering─offering ever so kindly, without any sort of trickery!─to forge the pact, but cruel, Mean Anden has been so frigid! So cold!
181.translation_description: Povero germoglio regale! Ti ho proposto... proposto con tanta gentilezza e senza alcun inganno di stringere il patto, ma il crudele e perfido Anden è rimasto gelido! Freddo come il ghiaccio!

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_EOTYR_005_002
182.description: Oooh, I won't let him get snatched up by anyone else. He's <hex:021A020203>My<hex:021A020103> Anden, and so he shall be from now till forever!
182.translation_description: Oh, non permetterò che qualcuno me lo porti via. È il Mio Anden, e sarà mio per sempre!

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_006_000
183.description: Whenever you come to visit me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I can't help but think of Ardbert.
183.translation_description: Ogni volta che vieni a trovarmi, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, non posso fare a meno di pensare ad Ardbert.

184.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_006_001
184.description: It was winter's end, the snow melting in the valley... “Back to our journey,” said he. “But sooner than you think, we'll meet again.” ...And that was the last I saw of him!
184.translation_description: Era la fine dell'inverno e la neve si scioglieva nella valle... «Torniamo al nostro viaggio», disse. «Ma ci rivedremo prima di quanto pensi». ...E fu l'ultima volta che lo vidi!

185.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_006_002
185.description: As far as I'm concerned, the only real villainy he's guilty of is keeping me waiting here so long! No matter what the rumors claimed, I always hoped to see them all crossing the valley again someday, hale and whole. Laughing together, as once we did...
185.translation_description: Per quanto mi riguarda, l'unica vera colpa di Ardbert è avermi fatto aspettare così a lungo! Qualunque cosa dicessero le voci, ho sempre sperato di rivederli attraversare la valle un giorno, sani e salvi. E ridere insieme, come un tempo...

186.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_006_003
186.description: Oooh, you didn't come to hear my sorrowful musings! Still, whenever I look at you, I feel as though something of Ardbert is there in your eyes... Heh, what a silly thing to say. My apologies.
186.translation_description: Oh, non sei qui per ascoltare i miei lamenti! Eppure, ogni volta che ti guardo, mi sembra di rivedere qualcosa di Ardbert nei tuoi occhi... Eh, che sciocchezza. Perdonami.

187.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_RANKUP_ANDEN_006_004
187.description: Promise me something, though, won't you? Go and visit your old friends from time to time. They miss you more than you could ever imagine.
187.translation_description: Però promettimi una cosa: vai a trovare i tuoi vecchi amici ogni tanto. Gli manchi più di quanto tu possa immaginare.

188.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
188.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Anden. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
188.translation_description: Hai consegnato ad Anden il massimo settimanale di sei oggetti. Potrai riprendere le consegne da <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

189.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_ANDEN_000_000
189.description: What is this feeling? Not sudden, per se...but new... Hmm...
189.translation_description: Che sensazione è questa? Non è del tutto nuova... eppure è diversa. Mmh...

190.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER9_00815_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_002
190.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Anden as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
190.translation_description: Per intraprendere la missione successiva, parla con Anden nei panni di un Discepolo dell'Artigianato o della Raccolta.
